title: LaneResult
description: What one lane agent returns. An empty findings array is a valid answer.

title.description: One-line summary. Start with the type being changed or the symptom.

severity.description: critical = data loss / crash / App Review rejection. high = reliability regression. medium = correctness quirk. low = nit / polish.

file.description: Path relative to the repo root.

lineRange.description: Single line '42' or inclusive range '120-135'. Omit only when the finding spans the whole file.

rootCauseCategory.description: Used to merge duplicate findings across lanes. 'other' is a last resort.

evidence.description: What the claim rests on: the quoted code at file:line, or the live API response or documentation it was checked against. A claim about GitHub or Apple API behaviour needs live data or the docs, not an assumption.

userImpact.description: What the user sees or suffers. If there is no user impact, it is not a finding.

suggestedFix.description: Concrete change, not a direction. 'Add deinit that cancels tasks', not 'consider lifecycle'.

blastRadius.description: small = one function/type. medium = one feature module. large = multiple features. cross-cutting = architectural or repo-wide.

testStrategy.description: The test that fails before the fix and passes after, or 'manual: <check>' when only a person can observe it.

assessment.description: architecture lane only: overall structural assessment, strengths and weaknesses.

opportunities.description: macos-platform lane only: platform features the app lacks. Not findings.

apis.description: Frameworks or APIs involved, and their minimum macOS version.
